narrative: An upper window across the close lit gold, the shadow of a head bent at an instrument. No face. The lane below is empty. You are not in the picture. You do not know the house.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stopped. Not pictured. Did not go in.

entities.name: the lady of the parish
entities.context: Heard, as the playing. Not named, and not seen as a face.

entities.name: the virginals
entities.context: In photo: A window lit gold
